source_documents.name: MRIQC structural IQMs for shared spatial definitions

dvars_nstd.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate larger frame-to-frame BOLD signal changes across the brain
caveats: interpret with framewise displacement and task/rest context

dvars_std.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate abnormal temporal signal change after standardization
caveats: interpret with dvars_nstd, fd_mean, fd_num, and visual report

dvars_vstd.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate abnormal temporal signal change after voxelwise standardization
caveats: use as supportive temporal instability evidence

fd_mean.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate greater average instantaneous head motion
caveats: thresholds should be study-specific

fd_num.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate more timepoints above the motion threshold
caveats: MRIQC uses a 0.20 mm FD threshold for this count

fd_perc.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate a larger fraction of the run exceeded the motion threshold
caveats: MRIQC uses a 0.20 mm FD threshold for this percentage

gcor.qc_interpretation: unusual values may indicate broad shared temporal structure across voxels
caveats: interpret in context of preprocessing, acquisition, and analysis design

tsnr.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor temporal signal stability
caveats: sensitive to acquisition and physiology as well as artifact

gsr_x.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate stronger EPI ghosting along the x phase-encoding direction
caveats: should be interpreted when phase-encoding direction is known

gsr_y.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate stronger EPI ghosting along the y phase-encoding direction
caveats: should be interpreted when phase-encoding direction is known

aor.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate a greater fraction of outlier voxels per fMRI volume
caveats: interpret with DVARS and FD

aqi.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate lower volume-wise similarity to the median fMRI volume
caveats: MRIQC describes lower values as better

dummy.qc_interpretation: indicates the number of initial non-steady-state volumes detected
caveats: not a direct image-quality failure signal by itself

efc.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate ghosting, blurring, or motion-related degradation
caveats: shared spatial metric definition from structural IQMs

fber.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate weak foreground signal relative to background noise
caveats: shared spatial metric definition from structural IQMs

fwhm_*.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate spatial blurring or reduced sharpness
caveats: interpret with acquisition resolution and preprocessing context

snr.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor BOLD image signal quality
caveats: not the same as temporal SNR

summary_*.qc_interpretation: describes image intensity distributions; useful for derived checks but weak as direct model evidence
caveats: usually only send if flagged or summarized

size_*.qc_interpretation: describes image dimensions; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself

spacing_*.qc_interpretation: describes image resolution; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself
